title: OWHS profile envelope v0.2
description: A profile is a JSON Schema applied to the whole instance after the core schema. The envelope names the profile, its version and the exact core schemas it targets. A profile may narrow core requirements; it cannot make a core-invalid record valid, weaken P1-P5 or introduce top-level fields outside ext.

profile_id.description: The namespace key this profile owns under ext.

core_schema_ids.description: Exact $id values of the core schemas this profile applies to.

schema.description: A Draft 2020-12 schema applied to the whole instance.
